title: SnapshotBundle
description: Strict content-addressed shard manifest schema for DeFi Garden. Cryptographically pins git commit, execution block number, run identifier, and content hashes across all shards to guarantee deterministic reproducibility and eliminate mixed-version CDN cache races.

git_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the engine code producing the snapshot.

as_of_block.description: Pinned consensus block number for all multicall reads in this snapshot.

hash.description: Content-addressed SHA-256 digest of this snapshot manifest bundle.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of snapshot finalization.

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID for the pinned block.

block_hash.description: EVM block hash corresponding to as_of_block.

status.description: Publishing lifecycle status of the shard manifest.

shards.description: Dictionary mapping shard identifier (e.g. pool address or market ID) to its content-addressed shard entry.

path.description: Content-addressed immutable path to the shard file.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the individual shard JSON content.

market_id.description: Unique on-chain market or pool identifier.
